member.name: T:Microsoft.Health.ApplicationDirectoryItem
member.summary: Defines the information for a HealthVault ApplicationDirectoryItem. An application directory item contains directory information for an application that works with HealthVault.
member.remarks: Directory information typically consists of short description of the application, and a detailed long description in html. Supplementary information like application screenshots, company details, etc. are also available.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Health.ApplicationDirectoryItem.#ctor
member.summary: Creates a new instance of the class with default parameters.

member.name: P:Microsoft.Health.ApplicationDirectoryItem.LargeLogo
member.summary: Gets or sets the large logo for the application.
member.remarks:
The large logo is shown at various times to the user when interacting with the HealthVault Shell. The large logo must be 120x60 pixels or smaller, and is limited to 160kb in size.
On updating an application configuration the large logo will only be updated if the value is not null.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Health.DirectoryProvider.GetApplicationDirectoryCollection(Microsoft.Health.HealthServiceConnection,Microsoft.Health.DirectoryDataOptions,System.Nullable{System.DateTime}@)
member.summary: Gets the list of application directory items from HealthVault.
member.param: to call HealthVault.
defines what set of data in (s) to retrieve. The calling application can request all languages for the response return values.
Returns the response's last modified datetime

returns.para: A collection of application directory items with localized element values available for the best match language or all languages as specified by the . In case of a language match, HealthVault service tries to find caller's current language identifier by first trying to match entire language specifier in the request (e.g. es-US), then just the language base (e.g. es), and as last resort, defaults to base language in HealthVault (e.g. en).

remarks.para: This method always calls HealthVault service to get the latest information. To improve performance and latency, it is recommended that the calling applications cache the return values, and only call this method to update their cache.
This method currently requires ApplicationConnection or AuthenticatedConnection.
